value.rationale: Motivated natural fixed-population tail/extremal invariants left untreated by the nearest first-passage resetting gas primary manuscript. Quantifies robust simultaneous rare negative excursions for arbitrary heterogeneous diffusivities/thresholds, discovers reset-threshold invariance of conditional extremes, and identifies physically consequential loss of finite stationary moments even above the positive recurrence threshold. Neither generic renewal existence nor homogeneous large-N densities furnish these values without new asymptotic analysis.
